text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ooooooohhhhhhhaaaaaaaahhhhhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Inari One reaches the goal!! Emerging 
victorious from this heart-wrenching, 
ferocious battle is Inari One!!
(WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Flat Cap-wearing Reporter
text_block_list.text:
What an incredible race...! This Mainichi 
Okan will go down in history without a 
doubt...!!

text_block_list.name: Flat Cap-wearing Reporter
text_block_list.text:
This is all thanks to you, Inari One...! 
You truly are the presence needed right 
now, in this era where Oguri Cap and the 
others shine so brilliantly...!
(Wooooo--!!!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Purple Scrunchie
text_block_list.text:
Big sis, you're really amazing...!! To run 
a race like that against someone called 
the center of the era...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, haa...!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (I... I won... I beat Oguri!!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Still――crap. My legs are shaking like 
crazy...――)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(This is a first for me. Oguri's 
running... that pressure... It feels like 
it's still clinging to my back—)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: —Inari.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Oguri—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Today is my loss. However, next time 
will not go the same way.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Wait for me at the Tenno Sho (Autumn). I 
will definitely defeat you there.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Dammit! She threw down the gauntlet, 
didn't she!? What good is winning if I 
can't pay her back properly!?)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Bring it on. Next time, I'm gonna take 
the win... for sure.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'm looking forward to running 
again.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Well, see you—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Dammit...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Pathetic...! I'm shaking again! Is this 
how a winner is supposed to act?!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(The next Autumn Tenno Sho isn't just 
about Oguri. Creek's gonna be there too, 
and yet—)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: "At this rate... I'm gonna—"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Dammit! Don't think about it. Anything 
but that, absolutely not—)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
It's no big deal...! I'll just train 
harder and win like I did today...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: That's right... that's all it is!

As we started on our way back from the 
racetrack, a heavy look still lingered on 
Inari One's face, despite her victory...

As I struggled to find the right words to 
say—

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
—Inari One was amazing! I never thought 
she'd actually beat Oguri.

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Just like Oguri, you gotta figure they 
came from the regional circuits precisely 
because they're strong~. Their hunger for 
victory must be insane, right?

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, well, it's true you don't stand out 
as much on the regional circuit. So it's 
like, all the more reason to give it 
everything! Ya know?

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly. Watching Inari One run 
today, she's way too good to stay only on 
the regional circuit. It's awesome seeing 
her shine in the Central league now.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
That ain't it...! I didn't mean it like 
that—

It feels like Inari One needs to put a 
little distance between herself and the 
voices around her right now...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
......Yeah, right. My bad, let's get 
going—
A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ngh...—

Inari One devotes herself to training for 
the Tenno Sho (Autumn). Although she's 
extremely earnest, she often wears a grim, 
heavy expression...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoops, Boss. What's with that face! 
You all right? I can't have you competing 
with the sky over who looks gloomier."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoops, Big Sis. What's with that 
face! You all right? I can't have you 
competing with the sky over who looks 
gloomier."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Get outta here! No need to worry! It's 
just been a bit cloudy lately, so I was 
feelin' a little under the weather, that's 
all!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Never mind that, you know it too, don't 
you? For the upcoming Tenno Sho (Autumn), 
this still isn't nearly enough!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
It ain't just Oguri, Creek's there too. 
Let's train harder and harder, Boss!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
It ain't just Oguri, Creek's there too. 
Let's train harder and harder, Sis!

We must continue to watch her closely. And 
if necessary, take action to protect Inari 
One herself.
choice_data_list:
(Even if that isn't what she truly 
wants...)

text_block_list.text:
"As a Trainer. As a partner. I am fully 
prepared for that—"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Haaah—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(...Damn it. Now I've gone and made even 
Boss worry.)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(...Damn it. Now I've gone and made even 
Big Sis worry.)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Still, honestly, my head's in the clouds. 
I can't seem to fully focus on training, 
either. I've gotta do something to fix 
this real quick...)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(They're definitely training right now 
too. In a realm beyond mine, pushing way 
harder than I am...!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (Besides—)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(The way I'm running right now... isn't 
doing anything to prove just how amazing 
everyone in Ohi is.)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Unless I win Umamusume of the Year... 
neither my running nor my words will ever 
prove a single thing...!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(And yet right now, I'm... to Oguri and 
Creek...—)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (At this rate, everyone's hopes will—)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Damn it... I gotta eat, but... I've got 
zero appetite......

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Damn it...!

The next Tenno Sho (Autumn) was drawing 
steadily nearer—
